entity.description: Allowlisted entity id, e.g. user, home, agent; lowercase snake; max 64

attribute.description: Allowlisted attribute from ontology enum OR quarantine bucket attribute

qualifier.description: Optional disambiguator, e.g. today, local; lowercase snake; max 64

value_struct.description: Structured value only — never a free-text diary blob as SoT

observed_at.description: Producer-claimed observation time (metadata; see clock-skew policy)

proposed_fact_key.description: Optional LLM suggestion; ignored unless validator accepts ontology path
